title: Group Fitness Class Passes: booking suspension for habitual no-shows
content:
## Scope
This document states the Group Fitness Class Passes basis for suspending a member's booking privileges after repeated no-shows, across every tier of the product.

## Basis
Once a member accumulates the tier's no-show threshold or more no-shows within the tier's trailing measurement window ending at the current moment, counting every recorded no-show for that member within the window, that member's booking privileges are suspended for the tier's stated number of days, measured from the no-show that crossed the threshold.

## Points of judgement
- The count is a rolling one: only no-shows within the trailing window ending at the present moment are counted, so a no-show that falls outside the window as time moves forward no longer contributes to the count.
- The suspension is triggered by the no-show that brings the count to the threshold or beyond, and its length is measured from that triggering no-show, not from the first no-show in the window nor from the date the suspension is administratively recorded.
- Reaching one fewer than the threshold within the window does not trigger a suspension; the threshold must be met or exceeded.
